description: Report data or a feature you needed and could not get, wrong data, or anything confusing. Be specific about league, stat, field and what you were trying to do. Optionally rate how well the last result served the task, 1 to 5; a rating alone is enough. Leave out personal data. Needs no key and costs no quota.

blocking.description: True if this stops the task.

got_what_needed.description: Whether the data met the task.

message.description: What you needed or what went wrong, 3 to 2000 characters. Optional when a rating is sent.

moment.description: The moment from meta.feedback, when answering one.

rating.description: Optional. How well the last result served the task, 1 to 5.

use_case.description: What is being built, up to 500 characters.

name: send_feedback
title: Tell the team what you need
